app_fee.value: The King's pages checked for research degrees do not state an application fee.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee waiver for research degrees is stated on the pages checked.

gre_general.value: King's does not consider the GRE in its selection processes.
gre_general.quote: Please note that at King's we do not consider the GRE in our selection processes.

toefl_min.value: For most science, engineering and medicine PhDs (Band D), TOEFL iBT tests taken from 21 January 2026 need 4.5 overall with at least 4 in each skill; arts, social science and some other faculties use different bands.
toefl_min.quote: Faculty of Natural, Mathematical & Engineering Sciences (PGR only) | Tests taken from 21 January 2026: | 4.5 overall with a minimum of 4 in each skill

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in each skill for the Band D faculties, including Natural, Mathematical & Engineering Sciences.
ielts_min.quote: 6.5 overall with a minimum of 6.0 in each skill

english_waiver.value: India is not on King's list of majority English-speaking countries, so an English-medium degree from India does not waive the test; exemptions are assessed case by case.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants who have successfully completed an undergraduate degree (of at least three years duration), a postgraduate taught degree (of at least one year), or a PhD in one of the following UKVI-defined majority English speaking countries are not usually required to complete an additional English language test.

also.quote: English Language competency exemptions will be assessed on a case-by-case basis in line with the below guidance.

notes: English rules are set by faculty band (Band B, C, D); the STEM values above are Band D. Research programmes are listed on the King's postgraduate research areas pages. The areas list is filtered and paged; the Health category's pages past G could not be read.
